zh-CN.headlineFact: 贸易、AI、创业、天象与选举同日进入行动点
zh-CN.headlineView: 今天比拼的是把倒计时变成执行清单
zh-CN.headlineFull: 贸易、AI、创业、天象与选举同日进入行动点；今天比拼的是把倒计时变成执行清单
zh-CN.intro: 欧盟小包裹新关税进入运营复盘，Google发布Pixel 11，SBA开讲融资，日全食横跨欧洲与北极；青年议题、世界马术锦标赛、赞比亚大选与欧洲田径赛同步推进。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 真正重要的不是知道今天会发生什么，而是提前把规则、资源和风险写进动作。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 九条倒计时一起归零，先把清单打开。

en-US.headlineFact: Trade, AI, entrepreneurship, an eclipse and an election reach action points
en-US.headlineView: today rewards turning countdowns into operating lists
en-US.headlineFull: Trade, AI, entrepreneurship, an eclipse and an election reach action points; today rewards turning countdowns into operating lists
en-US.intro: EU parcel duties enter an operating review, Google launches Pixel 11, the SBA teaches funding, and a total eclipse crosses Europe and the Arctic as youth, sport and Zambia's election move forward.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Knowing what happens today matters less than building rules, resources and risk into the action.
en-US.doudouQuote: Nine countdowns hit zero together; open the checklist.

sources.title: Google's Pixel 11 launch event is set for August 12
The Government launches the official website for Spain's three eclipses

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧盟3欧元小包裹关税进入第六周复盘
zh-CN.headlineView: 商品分类数据决定真实到岸成本
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧盟3欧元小包裹关税进入第六周复盘；商品分类数据决定真实到岸成本
zh-CN.intro: 欧盟已取消150欧元以下商品的关税豁免，并按包裹内不同商品类别临时征收每类3欧元；卖家应核对HS分类、前台税费展示、合单方式和本地履约后的真实毛利。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 跨境利润不能只看商品售价，分类数据和包裹结构已经直接进入成本表。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 一箱货里多一个类别，账单就可能多一格。

en-US.headlineFact: EU three-euro parcel duty enters its sixth-week review
en-US.headlineView: product classification data now shapes landed cost
en-US.headlineFull: EU three-euro parcel duty enters its sixth-week review; product classification data now shapes landed cost
en-US.intro: The EU removed the EUR150 duty exemption and temporarily charges EUR3 per item category in a parcel; sellers should review HS codes, checkout tax display, consolidation and local-fulfillment margins.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Cross-border margin now depends on classification data and parcel structure, not price alone.
en-US.doudouQuote: Add one category to a box and the bill may gain another line.

zh-CN.headlineView: 端侧AI进入真实设备与预订检验
zh-CN.headlineFull: Made by Google今天发布Pixel 11；端侧AI进入真实设备与预订检验
zh-CN.intro: Google Store确认8月12日在纽约直播新一代Pixel设备，并于当天开放Pixel 11预订；焦点从模型演示转向Gemini如何连接手机、穿戴与家庭设备的连续体验。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 端侧AI的价值不在发布会口号，而在设备之间能否稳定接住用户的下一步。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 模型上台只要一晚，协同体验要天天考试。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：人工智能 AI。

en-US.headlineFact: Made by Google launches Pixel 11 today
en-US.headlineView: on-device AI enters the device and preorder test
en-US.headlineFull: Made by Google launches Pixel 11 today; on-device AI enters the device and preorder test
en-US.intro: Google Store confirms a live New York launch and Pixel 11 preorders on August 12, shifting attention from model demos to how Gemini connects phones, wearables and home devices.
en-US.xiaziQuote: On-device AI earns value when devices reliably carry the user's next step, not on the keynote stage.
en-US.doudouQuote: A model gets one launch night; coordination gets tested daily.

sources.title: Google's Pixel 11 launch event is set for August 12

zh-CN.headlineView: 单人公司先把风险与还款路径说清楚
zh-CN.headlineFull: SBA创业融资课今天开讲；单人公司先把风险与还款路径说清楚
zh-CN.intro: 美国小企业管理局8月12日线上课程覆盖创业与增长贷款、项目匹配、贷款方评估与申请风险；单人经营者可据此整理现金流、资金用途、风险画像和偿付计划。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 融资材料的核心不是把愿景写大，而是让每一笔资金如何变成现金流可以被验证。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 一页还款路径，比十页豪言更像经营。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：一人公司 OPC。

en-US.headlineFact: SBA startup-funding classes go live today
en-US.headlineView: solo firms must explain risk and repayment clearly
en-US.headlineFull: SBA startup-funding classes go live today; solo firms must explain risk and repayment clearly
en-US.intro: August 12 SBA sessions cover startup and growth loans, program fit, lender evaluation and application risk, helping solo operators organize cash flow, use of funds and repayment plans.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Funding works when every dollar's path to cash flow can be verified, not when the vision grows longer.
en-US.doudouQuote: One repayment map beats ten pages of ambition.

sources.title: Wednesday Webinar: SBA Funding for Start-up Businesses
Access to Capital: Loan Application Mastery Webinar

zh-CN.headlineFact: 日全食今天横跨北极与欧洲
zh-CN.headlineView: 安全观测、交通与公共服务同时受考
zh-CN.headlineFull: 日全食今天横跨北极与欧洲；安全观测、交通与公共服务同时受考
zh-CN.intro: 8月12日日全食经过格陵兰、冰岛与西班牙等地，西班牙政府已设置官方观测点、交通和安全信息；观测者需使用合格滤镜，并提前核对天气、路线与人流安排。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 越稀有的天象，越需要把科学、交通和公共安全放进同一张地图。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 抬头看奇迹之前，先把合格观测镜戴好。

en-US.headlineFact: A total solar eclipse crosses the Arctic and Europe today
en-US.headlineView: safe viewing, transport and public services share the test
en-US.headlineFull: A total solar eclipse crosses the Arctic and Europe today; safe viewing, transport and public services share the test
en-US.intro: The August 12 eclipse crosses Greenland, Iceland and Spain, where official observation, transport and safety information is live; viewers need certified filters plus weather and route plans.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The rarer the sky event, the more science, transport and public safety belong on one map.
en-US.doudouQuote: Before watching the miracle, put on certified eclipse viewers.

sources.title: The Government launches the official website for Spain's three eclipses

zh-CN.headlineView: 青年参与要从被倾听走向共同决策
zh-CN.headlineFull: 国际青年日今天举行；青年参与要从被倾听走向共同决策
zh-CN.intro: 联合国将每年8月12日定为国际青年日，推动各地关注青年在发展、和平与公共治理中的角色；今年的行动重点仍落在让青年进入真实项目、资源分配和决策机制。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 青年参与不是活动席位，而是能否进入目标、预算和责任的共同设计。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 别只请年轻人上台，也要给他们一支笔。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：青年与社会。

en-US.headlineFact: International Youth Day is observed today
en-US.headlineView: youth participation must move from listening to shared decisions
en-US.headlineFull: International Youth Day is observed today; youth participation must move from listening to shared decisions
en-US.intro: The United Nations marks August 12 as International Youth Day, focusing attention on young people's roles in development, peace and governance and on access to real projects and decisions.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Youth participation is measured by access to goals, budgets and responsibility, not a seat at an event.
en-US.doudouQuote: Do not just invite young people on stage; give them a pen.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 亚琛盛装舞步团体奖牌今天决出
zh-CN.headlineView: 第二日大奖赛把稳定性变成最终排名
zh-CN.headlineFull: 亚琛盛装舞步团体奖牌今天决出；第二日大奖赛把稳定性变成最终排名
zh-CN.intro: 2026 FEI世界锦标赛盛装舞步大奖赛第二部分于8月12日进行，并决定团体奖牌及个人特别大奖赛资格；人马协作、节奏控制和动作精度进入同场检验。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 顶级表现不是一次惊艳动作，而是让每个细节在压力下仍然可重复。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 奖牌看起来很亮，背后全是稳定的小动作。

en-US.headlineFact: Aachen dressage team medals are decided today
en-US.headlineView: the second Grand Prix day turns consistency into ranking
en-US.headlineFull: Aachen dressage team medals are decided today; the second Grand Prix day turns consistency into ranking
en-US.intro: Part two of the FEI World Championships dressage Grand Prix runs on August 12, deciding team medals and qualification for the individual Grand Prix Special.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Elite performance is not one brilliant move; it is every detail remaining repeatable under pressure.
en-US.doudouQuote: Medals shine, but stable small moves build them.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 赞比亚进入大选投票前夜
zh-CN.headlineView: 认证、投票站与计票流程完成最后交接
zh-CN.headlineFull: 赞比亚进入大选投票前夜；认证、投票站与计票流程完成最后交接
zh-CN.intro: 赞比亚将于8月13日举行总统、议会与地方选举；国家计票中心已启动，选举机构、观察团、投票站人员与政党代理人进入投票前的最后流程确认。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 可信选举不是只守住投票日，而是让每一次交接都清楚、可追踪、可验证。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 选票明天进箱，流程今天就要对齐。

en-US.headlineFact: Zambia enters the eve of its general election
en-US.headlineView: accreditation, polling and results processes reach final handoff
en-US.headlineFull: Zambia enters the eve of its general election; accreditation, polling and results processes reach final handoff
en-US.intro: Zambia votes in presidential, parliamentary and local elections on August 13; the national results centre is active as officials, observers and party agents complete final checks.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A credible election depends on every handoff being clear, traceable and verifiable, not polling day alone.
en-US.doudouQuote: Ballots enter boxes tomorrow; the process must align today.

sources.title: About the EU Election Observation Mission Zambia 2026

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧洲田径锦标赛进入第三比赛日
zh-CN.headlineView: 多项目奖牌与积分推动国家排名变化
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧洲田径锦标赛进入第三比赛日；多项目奖牌与积分推动国家排名变化
zh-CN.intro: 2026欧洲田径锦标赛于8月10日至16日在伯明翰举行，8月12日进入第三比赛日；赛场同时检验速度、耐力、技术项目与大型赛事运营的连续稳定性。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 综合赛事的竞争不只在一场决赛，也在每个项目如何把团队积分持续累积。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 有人冲刺，有人投掷，奖牌榜一起跑。

en-US.headlineFact: European Athletics Championships enter day three
en-US.headlineView: medals across disciplines keep moving national rankings
en-US.headlineFull: European Athletics Championships enter day three; medals across disciplines keep moving national rankings
en-US.intro: The August 10-16 European Athletics Championships in Birmingham reach day three on August 12, testing speed, endurance, technical events and continuous major-event operations.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Championship strength grows not from one final alone but from points accumulated across disciplines.
en-US.doudouQuote: Some sprint, some throw; the medal table runs with them.
